package main

// CHAOS-5156: lizard's condition_counter is purely token-based, not
// construct-aware -- a bare "catch" token counts as a condition even used
// as an ordinary identifier (Go has no try/catch at all). This fixture
// exists so goConditions["catch"] has SOMETHING exercising it; see the
// fixture-coverage manifest test (assertEveryConditionExercisedByCorpus).
func catch() int {
	if true {
		return 1
	}
	return 0
}
